notices.title: ADMINISTRATIVE UPDATE TO MARADMIN 189/26 POLICY ON SERVICE EXTENSIONS DURING INVOLUNTARY SEPARATION PROCESSING
notices.description: R 282011Z OCT 26MARADMIN 539/26MSGID/GENADMIN/CMC WASHINGTON DC MRA MP//SUBJ/ADMINISTRATIVE UPDATE
notices.summary: The message rescinds authority to grant service extensions to Marines in involuntary administrative separation processing, effective immediately. Commands may not submit, endorse, or approve such extensions, and Marines who reach their expiration of active service before proceedings finish will be separated on that date.
